reviews.title: Disgusting!
reviews.body:
Wow! Just yeah…

Raised my issue with their ‘customer service’ team after 4 separate requests my concerns and instruction weren’t noted correctly.  

Raised feedback via trustpilot and their internal systems. 

Response - We will look into this and get back to you, chased again and we are still looking into this. 

Then today, I get an email from their ‘customer service team’ we haven’t heard from you in the past 5 days so it we don’t here from you in the next 48 hours then we will close the case. 

How cheeky! I have an open complaint, I haven’t been contacted appropriately since it was raised and now they email me to say they will close the case. 

How!

I am awaiting Lebara final response so that I can take them to the Communication Ombudsman.

reviews.title: Nobody in Lebara can read a file before sending ill-considered e-mails.
reviews.body: To start at the beginning would take too long, so let's start with the Ombudsman's determination that Lebara should pay me £50 in compensation. They provided a £50 credit which I was assured would never expire, but then kept telling me that it was about to expire. When I did try to use £5 of it, it didn't work. So Lebara offered to refund £50 to my bank, but only refunded £40 (to my credit card account, but that doesn't matter). I don't know how many hours they have spent trying to avoid paying the final £10: there was the near-scam suggestion that I should pay cash to them to release the £10, then an offer of PAYG credit.  I rejected that on 23 Oct 26, as PAYG is no use to me, and anyway wasn't what had been promised.  So nearly a month later they make exactly the same offer.  And having repeatedly promised only to contact me by e-mail once again they want to call! I'm not prepared to keep going round in circles, so it's back to the Ombudsman to draw attention to Lebara's effective failure to honour the Ombudsman's determination.  But I bet they'll try to call again.
